digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler cursor pagination + runaway-token guard
propositions: acli_graph.py hand-rolls the same nextPageToken cursor pagination loop three times without runaway-token guards, allowing a server that repeats the same token to spin indefinitely (cabc bug class).
A shared cursor iterator with runaway guard must be extracted and centralized, raising RunawayPaginationError when the server returns the same non-null token twice consecutively.

Each of the three map readers must route through the shared iterator and wrap the call with 'except RunawayPaginationError: raise' ahead of the catch-all fail-open handler to escape the degradation path.
The runaway guard must not propagate as a partial dict; RunawayPaginationError escapes the fail-open handler while ordinary transport exceptions still degrade to partial map as today.
Offset-protocol pagers (fetcher._iter_pages, jira_datacenter/transport.py::_paged_search) remain untouched and independently tested; cursor-protocol consolidation is out of scope.
